description: This file defines the MailMessage class, a specialized extension of Symfony's Email class, tailored for handling email messages within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for setting email subject, sender, recipients, body content, and CC/BCC addresses, with support for plain text and HTML content types.

classes.name: MailMessage
classes.description: A custom email message class extending Symfony's Email, providing convenient methods to construct email messages with support for content types and common email headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the email with a specified content type, defaulting to HTML.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender's email addresses and names.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the primary recipient email addresses.

methods.name: setMailBody
methods.description: Sets the email body, choosing between plain text and HTML based on the content type.
